name: Slack Notifications
description: Send messages, alerts, and rich blocks to Slack channels via the Bolt SDK or incoming webhooks.

requiredSecrets.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
requiredSecrets.reason: Incoming webhook URL for simple channel notifications

postInstallNotes:
1. Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add the `chat:write` scope, and install to your workspace.
2. Use `postMessage('#general', 'Hello!')` to send a simple message.
3. For webhooks-only use (no bot), set `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` and use `sendWebhook(text)`.
